## Summary

Describe the scoped change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] Type checking and linting pass when application code is present
- [ ] Production build passes when application code is present
- [ ] Browser or visual verification is recorded when UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, customer files, or unapproved claims are included

## WIZ content and privacy checks

- [ ] Product imagery is owned and approved for reuse
- [ ] Customer identities and logos are removed unless explicitly authorized
- [ ] Generated imagery is not presented as documentary factory evidence
- [ ] Price, MOQ, lead-time, certificate, and compliance claims are verified
